_readme: Every SMS the hub sends. The hub reads this file; edit wording here, not in code.
Messages to Noor need 'rw' (and 'en'). Messages to staff (agent, officers) can stay English, but fill 'rw' if they prefer it.
Keep {placeholders} exactly as written. One SMS is 160 characters; longer ones split into 2 and cost double.

noor_likely_bring_leaves.en: FarmFlow: this sounds like {diagnosis}. Please bring 5 affected leaves to {centre} so we can check.

noor_likely_no_photo.en: FarmFlow: this sounds like {diagnosis}. Dial {ussd} to see inputs you can get on credit.

noor_unsure.en: FarmFlow: we are not sure what this is. Your extension officer will contact you. You can also bring leaves to {centre}.

noor_confirmed.en: FarmFlow: the washing station confirmed {diagnosis}. Your coop is reviewing input credit for you.

noor_credit_ready.en: FarmFlow: your input credit of RWF {limit} is ready. Dial {ussd} to order.

agent_photo_result.en: Leaf: {diagnosis} ({conf}% sure). Suggested: {bundle}. Credit proposal sent to coop officer.

agent_photo_unsure.en: Not sure ({conf}%). Sent to the extension officer. Do not sell treatment yet.

agent_photo_quality.en: Photo {problem}. Please take it again in daylight, leaf filling the frame.

agent_help.en: D <id> <kg> [R<rejected kg>] log cherry / L <id> credit status / HELP

agent_error.en: Not understood. Try: D F0001 25.5 or L F0001

officer_request.en: FarmFlow: {name} {farmer_id}, {diagnosis}. Proposed credit RWF {limit} (low forecast {p10} kg). Reply OK {code} or NO {code}

officer_no_history.en: FarmFlow: {name} {farmer_id} asked for input credit but has under 2 seasons of deliveries. Please follow up.

extension_referral.en: FarmFlow referral: {name} ({village}, {phone}) wrote: {message}. Model not sure. Please follow up.
